title: Chapter 12 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the Real‑World Capstone concepts!

questions.question: Which command sets up a new Next.js project with Tailwind CSS pre‑configured?
questions.explanation: The `--tailwind` flag initialises the project with PostCSS and Tailwind CSS configured.

questions.question: In the Prisma schema, what does `@relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])` define?
options: A one‑to‑many relationship between Post and User
questions.explanation: The relation attribute links the `Post` model to the `User` model via the `authorId` foreign key.

questions.question: In the App Router, the NextAuth API route must be placed in `pages/api/auth/[...nextauth].js`.
questions.explanation: In the App Router, you create a route handler at `app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.js` and export `GET` and `POST`.

questions.question: How do you export the NextAuth handler for App Router?
options: export { handler as GET, handler as POST }
export const GET = handler; export const POST = handler
Both B and C are acceptable syntax
export const GET = handler; export const POST = handler
questions.explanation: You can either export named constants or use the shorthand `export { handler as GET, handler as POST }`. Both work.

questions.question: To enable ISR on an App Router page that queries a database directly (not using `fetch`), you export `const revalidate = ______;`.
questions.explanation: Setting `export const revalidate = 60` tells Next.js to regenerate the page at most every 60 seconds.

questions.question: What does `notFound()` from `next/navigation` do in a Server Component?
options: Renders the nearest `not-found.js` page with a 404 status
questions.explanation: `notFound()` programmatically triggers the 404 page and sets the appropriate HTTP status.

questions.question: In the comment Server Action, why is `getServerSession` used?
options: To get the currently authenticated user and attach their ID to the comment
questions.explanation: `getServerSession` reads the session from the request, allowing the server to know who is making the request.

questions.question: The `CommentForm` component can be a Server Component because it contains interactive form elements.
questions.explanation: It must be a Client Component because it uses `useSession`, `useFormState`, and event handlers.

questions.question: How is the post slug passed to the `addComment` Server Action?
options: By binding the slug as the first argument using `addComment.bind(null, slug)`
It is stored in a global variable
questions.explanation: `.bind()` creates a new function with the slug pre‑filled, leaving only `prevState` and `formData` for the form.

questions.question: After a comment is added, we call `revalidatePath('/posts/' + postSlug)` to ensure the page displays the new comment. This belongs to the ______ phase of the action.
questions.explanation: Revalidating the path purges the cache for that route, so the next visitor sees the updated data.

questions.question: Which prop should be added to the post's hero image to improve LCP?
questions.explanation: `priority` tells Next.js to preload the image and treat it as critical for the Largest Contentful Paint.

questions.question: What does the `images.domains` configuration in `next.config.js` do?
options: Limits the file size of images
Whitelists external image sources for the `next/image` component
Enables lazy loading for all images
Forces images to be served as WebP
questions.explanation: External images must come from domains listed in `images.domains` (or `remotePatterns`) to be optimized.

questions.question: In the root layout metadata template `%s | MyBlog`, what does `%s` represent?
questions.explanation: `%s` is a placeholder replaced by the specific page's `title` metadata.

questions.question: SQLite is a perfect choice for production databases on Vercel.
questions.explanation: Vercel's serverless environment has a read‑only filesystem, so SQLite databases are lost and can't be shared. Use a cloud database instead.

questions.question: What is the purpose of `next-sitemap`?
options: To create a visual sitemap of your app
To automatically generate sitemap.xml and robots.txt for SEO
To create a table of contents for blog posts
questions.explanation: It scans your static pages and dynamic routes to produce a standard sitemap file for search engines.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended step before launching a Next.js app to production?
options: Setting environment variables in the hosting dashboard
Testing the full user flow (sign in, create content, comment)
Disabling server‑side rendering for faster builds
questions.explanation: SSR is a core feature; disabling it would harm performance and SEO. All other options are good production practices.
